title: model clean-up batch reply, fixed speaker labels
description: What the clean-up model returns for one batch of a source whose speaker labels are fixed (corpuslm.model_cleanup, the Bee scheme). It never assigns a label: `roles` is optional and may only repeat a segment's own label.

edits.description: Changed segments only: segment index (as a string) to new text.

roles.description: Optional. Only a segment's own fixed label may be repeated, as [label, confidence]; a different label is rejected.

prefixItems.description: The segment's own speaker label, exactly as shown.

candidates.description: Candidate readings, the words as heard among them (prompt v2).

confidence.description: Confidence 0-1 in the pick; prompt v1 replies only (v2 gives probabilities).

probabilities.description: One probability per candidate, in the same order: the chance that candidate is what the speaker said. Sums to 1.

bindings.description: Label to name bindings the batch's dialogue supports.

role.description: The speaker label bound, exactly as shown in the batch.

anchor.description: Verbatim words from that segment supporting the binding.

confidence.description: Confidence 0-1 that this dialogue names the role.
